title: Deeper and Darker Soul Elytra with Cataclysm Ignitium Chestplate
description: Adds a new fusion item that combines the Cataclysm Ignitium Chestplate with the Deeper and Darker Soul Elytra, providing both protection and full elytra flight in one piece.
body:
# Used mods in this project:
![deeperdarker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb9db54518226803a586d84b1d4322ac122d015f.png) ![lendercataclysm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f861aceb3ba215dd1a35a2cd3c021d9c94d293d7.png)

This mod adds a new fused variant of the Ignitium Chestplate by combining it with the Soul Elytra from Deeper and Darker. The result is a single piece of equipment that offers the full protection of Ignitium armor wwith elytra flight of Soul Elytra, allowing the player to gain additional speed when flying.


**Dependencies**\
[L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm) version 3.28 and higher\
[Deeper and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker) version 1.3.3 and higher
